title: Little Geniuses: Coding, Design & AI Fun Lab | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Little Geniuses: Coding, Design & AI Fun Lab. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 2 months. Description: A fun and creative summer learning experience for kids to explore computers, games, design, and Artificial Intelligence through hands-on activities, including creating digital artwork and building animations. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
